title: At the bus stop
summary: A simple dialogue about waiting for a bus and asking basic questions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, is this the bus to the city center?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you know when it comes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It comes in about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're welcome.

title: Meeting a new classmate
summary: Two students introduce themselves before class.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, I am Anna.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hi, I am Leo.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you new here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I am.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I am in this class too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice to meet you too.

title: In the cafe
summary: A basic cafe order with simple food and drink vocabulary.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello. Can I have a coffee, please?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. Anything else?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, a sandwich, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Cheese or chicken?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Cheese, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is six euros.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here you are.

title: At home
summary: A short home conversation using there is and there are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your room is nice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there a desk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, there is a desk near the window.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are there any books on it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, there are two books and a notebook.

title: Looking at a family photo
summary: A simple dialogue about family members.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This is my sister.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she older than you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you got any brothers?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I have got one brother.

title: Missing the bus
summary: Two friends talk about being late and making a new plan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where are you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am at the bus stop.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you catch the bus?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I missed it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh no. What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am going to take the next one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, I will wait for you.

title: At the supermarket
summary: A customer asks for help finding items in a supermarket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, do you have any bread?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it is over there, next to the milk.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. And where can I find some apples?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They are in the fruit section.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you have any fresh juice?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, we have orange and apple juice.

title: Booking a doctor's appointment
summary: A patient calls to make an appointment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning. I would like to book a doctor's appointment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have a headache and a fever.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I see. Are you free this afternoon?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, I am.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The doctor can see you at three o'clock.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That works for me. Thank you.

title: A problem in the apartment
summary: A tenant reports a small maintenance problem.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi. I am calling about the apartment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The kitchen tap started leaking last night.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it leaking now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, it is. The water is dripping all the time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Okay. I am going to send someone tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you very much.

title: Weekend plans
summary: Two friends make plans for the weekend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What are you going to do this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am going to visit my cousin.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. Are you going by train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, I am going by car.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What about Sunday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I am free on Sunday. We can meet then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Let's have lunch together.

title: A call after a job interview
summary: A candidate talks to a friend after an interview.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How did the interview go?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I think it went well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What did they ask you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They asked about my experience and why I wanted the position.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you heard from them yet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, not yet. But they said they would email me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds promising.

title: Planning a group project
summary: Students discuss tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We need to finish the project by Friday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I can do the slides if you write the introduction.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That works. What about the data?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mila has already collected most of it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. If we divide the work now, we will finish on time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agreed. Let's send everyone a message tonight.

title: Taking the wrong train
summary: Two travelers realize they may be on the wrong train and solve the problem.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I think we have made a mistake.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Why? What happened?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This train has just stopped at the wrong station.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. I have checked the route on my phone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So what do we do now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If we get off here, we can catch the next train back.

title: Talking about workload
summary: Two coworkers discuss stress and time management.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look tired. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I have had a very busy week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Too many meetings?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and I have also been working on two deadlines at the same time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds stressful.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is. I need to organize my time better.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe you should talk to your manager.

title: After a family visit
summary: Two friends talk about a recent family gathering.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How was your weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It was nice. I visited my parents.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have not seen mine for months.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Really? We had lunch together and talked for hours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds lovely.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. My mother made my favorite soup, which she always cooks when I come home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I miss home too.
